limits: Recomputed scoring from 360 existing saved GPU generation records; no GPU replication, model load, new inference, or optimizer update. Semantic grades in the natural validation record were not regraded.

natural_selection.semantic_limits: Verified arithmetic and documented gates using fixed underlying semantic counts; no independent regrading of photographs/dialogue or rerun of generation.

ci_record.scope: Actual completed GitHub CI at the fixed repair commit: lint and CPU-oriented test suites on Windows, Linux and macOS. This is release-control and repository testing, not independent lesson reviews, full model training, or a remote Colab run. The environment check records its actual chosen device; when MPS is present it performs only a 256x256 matrix forward/backward and a 32x32 CPU comparison, not the full course on MPS. Signed log redirects were read without forwarding the GitHub Authorization header.

record.authentication: no explicit secret or credential helper

original_anonymous_asset_record_audit.scope: Audited existing bytes and retained 2026-10-02 anonymous-download execution receipt. Did not independently repeat the network download.
